arguments.value: 62-year-old man with 10 months of progressive dyspnea after COVID-19 infection, initially treated as CTD-ILD based on CT findings and RO-52/EJ antibodies, but later found on re-review of transbronchial cryobiopsy and BALF NGS/PAS staining to have pulmonary Tropheryma whipplei infection superimposed on long COVID. Improved with ceftriaxone followed by trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole and steroid taper.
